outcome: cancer mortality in children under 5 years old
cohort: Two birth cohorts of children born in Korea, totaling 3,323,613 births from 1995-1999 and 2,297,876 births from 2010-2014, constructed by linking national birth data to under-5 death data.
finding: Social inequalities in under-5 cancer mortality risk, based on paternal education and employment status, widened between 1995-1999 and 2010-2014, with lower parental social class associated with a higher risk of under-5 cancer mortality.
